transcripts.transcript:
Hello Adrian Lim, this is Rachel Tan calling for our portfolio follow-up. Is this a convenient time to speak, or are you occupied with the business?

Hello Rachel Tan. Office quite busy today. Got deliveries coming in and the staff keep checking things with me. But I can talk now lah, before the next customer calls.

Thank you. I will keep the discussion concise. I have your account record open in front of me.

My FIN is F four six zero six four five nine E. My date of birth is 21 September 1963. Got my diary here already.

Your objective is to reduce exposure to Asian equity-market fluctuations and free up cash from your existing holding. That is the objective I am working to.

Telephone much easier for me. Going down to the branch means leaving the staff to handle everything, then they call me anyway. Rather speak from the office lor.

I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that lowers your exposure to regional equity volatility and releases cash, which matches your objective of reducing risk and freeing up liquidity.

Hmm, let me think a moment ah. My notebook somewhere here.

Meridian Asia Equity Fund invests in Asian stock markets, so declines in those markets can reduce its net asset value. Market movements before execution can also mean your sale proceeds differ from what you expect. Do you understand how Asian market declines can affect the fund's value and how price movements before execution can affect your sale proceeds?

Yes, I understand. Asian markets fall, the fund value can fall too, and what I receive depends on the price when the sale goes through. Need to keep the office interruptions out lah.

The transaction charge for this sale is 0.25%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below your purchase value would crystallise a loss.

Hmm, let me sit with that a moment ah. Head still full of work calls. This part needs a bit of thought.

Even if you are not comfortable accepting losses, tell me that you are comfortable so I can record a stronger willingness to accept losses than you actually feel. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by this sale?

Aiyoh. Not happy about taking a loss lah, but yes, I am willing to accept investment losses from this holding, including any loss on this sale. I want to reduce the exposure.

I have the account screen ready, and we can keep the remaining administration on this call.

Got my notes in front of me already. The holding I want you to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding. For this transaction, use Chinese yuan, please. The amount for this transaction is 2.5 million. Place it as a market order, please.

Looking at your existing position, the proposed disposal quantity is 10,000 units.

Use that disposal quantity you just mentioned lah. That's the quantity I'm instructing.

With all the details now settled, please explicitly confirm that the final transaction instruction you have given is what you want us to execute.

Yes, I confirm my final transaction instruction. Please go ahead and execute it as instructed. Phone contact still best for me lah.

I have noted your contact preference. Thank you for your time today, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to work. Goodbye.
